seo.title: Class Timetable | FIT X Studio, Manunda Cairns
seo.description: This week's strength, mat Pilates, mums and bubs, Saturday HIIT and open gym sessions at FIT X Studio, Manunda. Book online with Mindbody.

hero.headline: Find your class.
hero.sub: Live times from our booking system. Classes open two weeks ahead and you can cancel free up to 12 hours before.

items.label: New to FIT X
items.title: 2 weeks unlimited
items.body: Every class for two weeks. Counts towards your Premium minimum term if you stay.

items.label: Just one class
items.title: Casual visit
items.body: Strength $20, mat Pilates $15, open gym $25. Or save with a 10-class pack.

items.label: Already a member
items.title: Book below
items.body: Pick a class, tap Book and sign in with your Mindbody account.

schedule.headline: This week
schedule.note: Booking a class needs a pass or membership.

items.title: What to bring
items.body: Water bottle, towel and enclosed training shoes. Grip socks for mat Pilates (bring yours or buy from us).

items.title: Cancelling
items.body: Free up to 12 hours before class. If you miss three booked classes in 30 days without cancelling in time, a $10 fee applies from the third.

items.title: Getting here
items.body: Shed 6, 261–273 McCormack Street, Manunda. Designated customer parking on site, plus on-street parking.
